result.question: Why were the leaders of Shechem inclined to follow Abimelech?

readings.support: for they said, “He is our brother.”

readings.answer: Because his mother’s brothers spoke these words about him to the leaders.
readings.support: when his mother’s brothers spoke all these words about him in the presence of all the leaders of Shechem | their hearts were inclined to follow Abimelech

assessments.reason: Verse 3 explicitly gives the reason: “their hearts were inclined to follow Abimelech, for they said, ‘He is our brother.’” This matches the key.

The clause “when his mother’s brothers spoke…” is temporal context; the stated reason is introduced by “for they said, ‘He is our brother.’” So attributing the cause to the brothers’ speech misidentifies the reason.

result.reason: The passage explicitly states the reason as “for they said, ‘He is our brother,’” which matches the key.
